top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Holst (incretin physiology, GLP-1 secretion and action), Mojsov (the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form) and Drucker (proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor pharmacology), a discovery chain whose therapeutic consequence for type 2 diabetes and obesity is mature and replicated in independent randomized programmes. The attribution is imperfect, since Knudsen is outside the cap and Mojsov's priority cannot be verified from the supplied material, but a citation worded around the hormone, its actions and its active form is defensible and clearly better than no award.
